items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued November 12 at 1:26PM EST until November 13 at 10:00PM EST by NWS Caribou ME
items.description:
* WHAT...Northeast winds 10 to 20 kt with gusts up to 25 kt.

* WHERE...Intra Coastal Waters from Schoodic Point, ME to
Stonington, ME.

* WHEN...From 1 AM to 10 PM EST Friday.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
